title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what information may be processed when you visit the SAGAR2027 website and how the website's features handle it.

sections.title: Information you provide
paragraphs: If you contact the organizers using the published email addresses, they receive the information and contact details included in your message so they can respond. The website itself does not provide a contact form.

sections.title: Chat assistant and voice input
paragraphs: The website's chat assistant generates replies from conference information in the page. Chat messages are held in the browser while the page is active and are not submitted to a website application server.
If you use voice input, speech recognition is provided by your browser or device and is subject to that provider's privacy practices.

sections.title: Analytics
paragraphs: The website includes Vercel Analytics to measure website usage. Vercel may process technical or usage information under its own privacy policy.

sections.title: Browser storage
paragraphs: The website stores your selected light or dark theme in your browser's local storage so the preference can be remembered on your next visit.

sections.title: Third-party websites
paragraphs: Links to services such as Microsoft CMT and other external websites are subject to the privacy policies of those services. Review their policies before providing information to them.

sections.title: Questions about privacy
paragraphs: For privacy questions related to the conference website, contact the SAGAR2027 organizing committee.
